pages.title: What It Gives
pages.text:
Permanence. The only path that answers whether this will still be here tomorrow.

It wins nothing. It refuses to lose.

pages.title: Your First Hour
pages.text:
1. A keypad and a reinforced door on the one room that matters.
2. Cameras where you cannot see.
3. KEYCARDS come off the dead when you walk this path. Keep them - they open more than doors.
4. Reinforced blocks resist blast. That is the whole point, and they are not found above.
